repository.name: @webex/plugin-authorization-browser-first-party
repository.purpose: First-party (Webex web client) browser authorization plugin registered as webex.authorization. It starts OAuth authorization-code logins with CSRF state and PKCE (S256), completes them automatically on the redirect page load (CSRF check, URL scrubbing, best-effort preauth catalog, code exchange), supplies the browser token-refresh callback with public or confidential client authentication, handles the third-party login callback, runs device (QR code) login through the oauth-helper service with qRCodeLogin events, and redirects on logout.

authorization-browser-first-party-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing it registers Authorization as public plugin 'authorization' with proxies isAuthorizing and isAuthenticating and the credentials config defaults (clientType 'public', refreshCallback) from src/config.js; the first registration of the name wins. Named exports are Events, InitialAuthorizationCodeGrantOutcomes, and config. The plugin API on webex.authorization is initiateLogin, initiateAuthorizationCodeGrant, requestAuthorizationCodeGrant, initiateThirdPartyLogin, initiateThirdPartyLoginRedirect, handleThirdPartyCallback, initQRCodeLogin, cancelQRCodePolling, and logout. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md; the class JSDoc marks it private to the Webex web client.

authorization-plugin-events.summary: Events on webex.authorization.eventEmitter, which is shared by all instances: 'login' with eventType initiateLogin {hasEmail, hasState} or redirectToLoginUrl {loginUrl}, and 'qRCodeLogin' with eventType getUserCodeSuccess (userData), getUserCodeFailure, authorizationPending, authorizationSuccess, authorizationFailure (data), or pollingCanceled.

idbroker-oauth-endpoints.source: Identity broker authorize, logout, and token endpoints (URLs from webex-core credentials config; route definitions are not in this repository)
idbroker-oauth-endpoints.summary: Login and logout pages are reached by navigation to URLs built by credentials. The token endpoint at config.tokenUrl receives authorization_code forms (redirect_uri, code, self_contained_token, optional code_verifier) and refresh_token forms, with client_id in the form for public clients or HTTP Basic client credentials otherwise; a 400 body carries an OAuth error string.

oauth-helper-device-authorization.source: oauth-helper service (reached as service name 'oauth-helper' through the services catalog; route definitions are not in this repository)
oauth-helper-device-authorization.summary: POST /actions/device/authorize with {client_id, scope} returns user_code, verification_uri, verification_uri_complete, device_code, interval, and expires_in; POST /actions/device/token with the device_code URN grant returns the token body, 428 while pending, or 400 with message slow_down. Both use HTTP Basic client credentials.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Authorization extends WebexPlugin in namespace Credentials, is registered with registerPlugin (first-wins, proxies supported), sends requests with this.webex.request, reads this.webex.getWindow(), and is called by WebexCore#logout.

webex-core-credentials.summary: buildLoginUrl, buildThirdPartyLoginUrl, and buildLogoutUrl build URLs; credentials.set({supertoken}) stores tokens; grantErrors.select maps OAuth error strings; credentials calls config.refreshCallback to refresh a browser token; config.tokenUrl names the token endpoint.

webex-core-services.summary: collectPreauthCatalog(hint) is called before the startup exchange with {emailhash} or {orgId} or no hint; get('oauth-helper') supplies the helper URL embedded in the QR verification URL.

webex-common-utilities.summary: oneFlight and whileInFlight decorate requestAuthorizationCodeGrant and initiateAuthorizationCodeGrant; encodeState and decodeState carry the OAuth state as base64url JSON.

crypto-js.summary: SHA256 hashes the email and the PKCE verifier; enc-base64url encodes the challenge and supplies the verifier alphabet.

lodash.summary: cloneDeep, isEmpty, omit, and isObject for option cloning, state validation, and URL cleanup.
